messages:
maya: hi team! day 3 here. quick org question  who do I ping for: model onboarding (getting a model into the catalog), private/VPC deploy approvals, and embedding index quota increases?

alex: welcome maya :wave: Model onboarding -> @alex (eng-runtime) owns the model catalog + verification steps. share model artifact path, config (vocab, hf config), and a 1-paragraph risk note.

mina: VPC/private deploy approvals -> infra (that's me). open a ticket in the infra queue and include the deploy diagram + subnet IDs. for expedited onboarding, DM me the ticket number.

sam: embedding infra (indexing/ANN) -> ping #eng-ml and cc @sam. if you need extra CPU/GPU for batch indexing, include dataset size and expected queries/sec.

maya: thanks! is there a checklist or required tests for model verification?

alex: yes, run the onboarding script in the repo:
```
./scripts/onboard_model.sh --model-path s3://... --min-tests 5
```
Include eval artifacts (regression, latency). We'll run a canary on staging for 24h before catalog mark `approved`.

jordan: security gating: if model has PII or customer data, tag `sensitive=true` in the ticket and notify me. Security reviews must be started before private deploy.

maya: what's the escalation flow if a staging canary causes errors in prod routing?

sre-oncall: standard flow: oncall gets paged first. if unresolved after 10m, escalate to oncall lead -> eng-sre -> product-owner. for security-impacting stuff, page @jordan immediately. always post incident link in #incidents.

ops-bot: Action: added maya to `redwood-oncall` group and `eng-ml` Slack channel.

mina: embedding index quota increases: open an infra ticket and include estimated index size and QPS. quota requests under 50GB are usually 1-2 business days. over 50GB needs capacity planning.

maya: great. one more  who signs off on production model rollouts?

alex: rollout signoff = engineering owner (me) + product + security (if sensitive) + infra for ops. we use the Rollouts doc in the console (Console > Deployments > Rollouts) and require a checklist sign-off in the ticket.

maya: perfect. will follow that flow. i'll open the onboarding ticket now and ping you all. thanks! :thumbsup:

alex: welcome again! ping if you want a walkthrough of the onboarding script later today.

maya: yes please, that would help :grinning:
